reason: I'd take the free first collab, sure, but I don't pay for creator tools. Cafés here pay me in food anyway, so paying ₹499 to get more dosa-for-a-reel deals doesn't add up.
objection: Local cafés pay in food, not money. If the collabs on Mitra are mostly barter, the pass costs me real cash for nothing I can bank. And the café that sent me the link makes ₹150 off me, plus I'd owe promo videos on top.
would_change_my_mind: If my first collab through Mitra actually paid cash, or the pass came free with a paid collab, so it paid for itself before I spent anything.
